Results show strong negative associations between life history strategy (Mini-K and HKSS) and DSM-5 psychopathology, supporting the focal claim.

result_raw.result_text: In OLS controlling for Age, Mini-K negatively predicts DSM-5 psychopathology (b = -0.642, p < 1e-9; n = 138). Partial correlations controlling Age are also negative and significant for both Mini-K and HKSS.

conclusion.conclusion_text: Higher life history strategy scores (Mini-K, HKSS) are associated with lower DSM-5 psychopathology, supporting the focal claim.
